info.title: Gumball Developer API
info.description:
Gumball's developer API generates AI fashion imagery (AI fashion model, ghost mannequin, flat-lay) from your product photos, using the same engine and the same credit pool as the Gumball studio app. No rate limits — per-credit billing is the only consumption control.

Keys are managed in the studio dashboard (**app → API**: issue, show-once, revoke, usage analytics). The API draws the same credit pool as your studio workspace, so subscribing/topping up on the plan page is how you buy capacity.

## Quickstart

Create a generation, then poll until it is complete. Requires an **active Studio ($39.99/mo) subscription** or credits in top-up balance.

```bash
curl https://api.gumball.fashion/v1/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer gb_YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "image_url": "https://cdn.yourstore.com/products/dress.jpg",
    "tool": "model",
    "scene": "studio",
    "pose": "standing",
    "size": "PORTRAIT_HD_3_2",
    "model_preset": "avery",
    "prompt": "soft window light, editorial styling"
  }'
# → 202 {"id":"c9f…","status":"queued","location":"…/v1/generations/c9f…"}
```

```bash
curl https://api.gumball.fashion/v1/generations/c9f… \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer gb_YOUR_KEY"
# → { "status": "complete", "images": [{ "status": "complete", "url": "…/v1/generations/c9f…/image/i123" }] }
```

**Python (requests)**

```python
import requests, time
API = "https://api.gumball.fashion"
H = {"Authorization": "Bearer gb_YOUR_KEY"}
r = requests.post(f"{API}/v1/generations", headers={**H, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  json={"image_url": "https://cdn.yourstore.com/products/dress.jpg", "tool": "model", "scene": "studio"})
r.raise_for_status()
gid = r.json()["id"]
while True:
    d = requests.get(f"{API}/v1/generations/{gid}", headers=H).json()
    if d["status"] not in ("queued", "running"):
        break
    time.sleep(2)
print(d)
```

**Node / TypeScript (fetch)**

```javascript
const API = "https://api.gumball.fashion";
const g = await fetch(API + "/v1/generations", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer gb_YOUR_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ image_url: "https://cdn.yourstore.com/products/dress.jpg" }),
});
const { id } = await g.json();
// poll GET /v1/generations/{id} every 2-5s until status completes
```

## Authentication

Every `/v1` call is Bearer-authed with a workspace-scoped key created in the **studio → app → API** card (click "Create key", copy the plaintext *once* — it's stored as a SHA-256 hash only). Each key maps to one workspace; usage is metered on the same pool that workspace's UI shows (usage is listed under the API card). Revoking keys is instant and returns `403 API_KEY_REVOKED` on next use.

| Header | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer gb_<8 hex>_<32 hex>` (e.g. `gb_1a2b3c4d_deadbeef…`) |

## Tool guide

Six AI tools are available. Image tools reserve **15 credits per output image**; motion video reserves credits = 15 × fashn units (see table).

| tool | Accepts | Primarily for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | scene · pose · size · prompt · model_preset / custom_model_id · additional_image_urls | Virtual-model photoshoots: your garment worn by an AI model in a chosen scene/pose. The workhorse for campaign imagery. |
| `ghost-mannequin` | size · prompt | Clean mannequin-free photos that show fit/drape. Product-page safe. |
| `flat-lay` | size · prompt | Top-down packshots for e-commerce & marketplaces. |
| `motion-video` | duration (5\|10 s, default 5) · resolution (480p\|720p\|1080p, default 480p) · prompt | Short product motion clips from one product photo (async — poll like any generation; `images[n].url` serves `video/mp4`). |
| `remove-bg` | — (just the image) | Transparent PNG cutouts of your subject for overlays, compositing and marketplace whitening (async). |
| `reframe` | aspect_ratio (21:9 · 1:1 · 4:3 · 3:2 · 2:3 · 5:4 · 4:5 · 3:4 · 16:9 · 9:16; default 1:1) | Marketplace-ready aspect ratios: AI outpaints (zoom-out) or crops (zoom-in) around your subject. Fails when the source already matches within 2% — credits are released. |

**Motion credit cost:** 480p=1 unit, 720p=3, 1080p=6; 10 s doubles it. At 15 cr/unit: 5s 480p = **15**, 5s 720p = **45**, 5s 1080p = **90**. `/v1/catalog` returns exact `motions` pricing per combination.

**Model semantics:** choose a `custom_model_id` (any enabled custom model from `/v1/catalog` — takes precedence) or a `model_preset` slug (default `'avery'`). Platform-managed `model_catalog` gates both; unknown/disabled values → `400 MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE`.

## Generation states

| status | Meaning | Billing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `queued` | Credits reserved; provider run submitting. | Reserved (uncommitted) |
| `running` | Provider executing. Poll again. | Reserved |
| `complete` | Image ready; `images[n].url` present. | Charged (15 cr) |
| `partial` | Some versions failed (per-image error attached). Only successful images are charged. | Charged per success |
| `failed` | All failures. Credits released — you only pay for successes. | Release / no charge |

A poll response's `images[].error` carries the provider failure reason (shown truncated).

## Managing generations

- `DELETE /v1/generations/{id}` — deletes a generation, its images and any pending credit reservations; stored outputs are removed. Releases everything not yet charged.
- `POST /v1/generations/{id}/images/{imageId}/regenerate` — queues a fresh render of one image from the same config (charges standard tool cost again). `409 IMAGE_IN_PROGRESS` if that image is still queued/running.

## Credits & pricing

Identical to the studio app — all API generations draw one pool per workspace, so your accounting code never special-cases "manual" vs API traffic.

- **Pro $39.99/mo** → 3,000 credits ≈ 200 images @ **15 credits / image**.
- **Top-ups (pay-as-you-like):** 100 credits per $1, minimum $10; manage them on the plan page (gumball.fashion/app/plan).
- **Reservation:** credits reserve atomically at `POST /v1/generations` time (equal-opportunity with studio submissions — if the studio has 20 reserved, those count against your pool).
- **Refunds:** failed generations (network/provider) release their reservation automatically.
- **Transactions** are visible to your users on their Studio history; usage analytics under the API card in studio. No separate "API billing" plan.

## Limits & best practices

- **No rate limits** on `/v1/*` — consumption is controlled purely by credits. Failed calls cost nothing; still, batch-responsibly (every `POST /v1/generations` = 1 output image).
- Polling at 2–5 s intervals is plenty.
- Built for server-to-server: no CORS-specifics to configure — `api.gumball.fashion` returns permissive `access-control-allow-origin: *`.
- Images are stored under workspace-scoped keys (`generated/{workspaceId}/…`).
- Webhook delivery for generation completion is **not** part of v1 — poll (or use the MCP `check_generation` tool). If you need webhooks, tell support.

## MCP server (code with a coding assistant)

Hosted Model Context Protocol server for Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf etc. Stateless — every request authenticates with the Bearer key. Tools call the same core services, so MCP usage draws the same credit pool as this API.

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http gumball https://mcp.gumball.fashion/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer gb_YOUR_KEY"
```

**Cursor / Windsurf:** add a streamable-HTTP MCP server `https://mcp.gumball.fashion/mcp` with the same header.

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `get_catalog` | Same content as GET /v1/catalog (tools · models · scenes · poses · sizes · motion pricing · costs). |
| `create_generation` | Wraps POST /v1/generations (same fields incl. motion-video; same validation errors). |
| `check_generation` | Wraps GET /v1/generations/{id} (returns download URL when complete). |
| `list_recent_generations` | Last N generations for the workspace. |
| `delete_generation` | Deletes a generation and releases uncharged reservations. |
| `regenerate_image` | Queues a fresh render of one image from a generation. |
| `get_quota` | Same as GET /v1/quota. |
| `get_api_reference` | REST reference (text) so an assistant can scaffold 3rd-party apps with you. |

## FAQ

**Must I host images on your platform?**
No. `image_url` just needs to be fetchable by the provider (http/s).

**Base64 input?**
No — use any http/s image host. `data:` and base64 embeddings are rejected.

**Can I request multiple images per shoot?**
Not in v1 — one output per call.

**How do I avoid being billed for a failed generation?**
You don't need to do anything — failed generations release credits automatically; only successes settle (mirrors the studio behavior exactly).

**Shared sandbox?**
Keys are workspace-scoped and billed against one shared pool — rotate for teammates anytime from the dashboard.

**Production key vs staging key?**
Keys are issued per environment (staging keys live in the staging D1). Use the `gumball-api-staging` workers.dev endpoint only while testing — credits come from the same staging studio pool.

## Changelog

**v1.0 — 2026-09-29**: REST surface (generations, catalog, quota); bearer keys; MCP server; no rate limits; same-billing-invariant pipeline.
**v1.1 — 2026-10-01**: `motion-video` tool (duration/resolution/prompt, async polling, MP4 output); `DELETE /v1/generations/{id}`; `POST /v1/generations/{id}/images/{imageId}/regenerate`; catalog now prices motion units and reads admin-managed tool costs; MCP `delete_generation` + `regenerate_image` tools.
**v1.2 — 2026-10-16**: `remove-bg` (transparent PNG cutout) and `reframe` (aspect_ratio retarget) tools — both async, poll like any generation; `aspect_ratio` request field; all poll/download endpoints settle async rows on request.

## Support

Questions or integrations help: tickets@gumball-studio.p.tawk.email or the support chat in the studio app.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: What you can generate and what it costs

bearerAuth.description: API key issued in the studio dashboard (app → API): format `gb_<hex>` / `prefix gb_…` stored SHA-256. Never commit keys client-side.

remaining.description: Credits still left in the workspace pool when the request was refused. Nothing was reserved.

id.description: Photoshoot id — use it on every poll/download call.

post.description: Reserves credits atomically from the workspace pool (same math as the studio app) and dispatches the provider run. One output image per request (result image, not the source). A billing failure never reserves credits — the POST is all-or-nothing.

image_url.description: Publicly fetchable garment image URL (http/s). The provider fetches it directly — host it somewhere reachable. data: URLs are rejected.

additional_image_urls.description: Extra garment angle URLs sent to the provider (up to 4). Duplicates of image_url are ignored.

tool.description: `model` puts the garment on an AI fashion model (choose model via model_preset/custom_model_id, scene, pose). `ghost-mannequin` and `flat-lay` accept only size/prompt. `motion-video` makes a short product clip (duration/resolution/prompt; async, output served as video/mp4). `remove-bg` returns a transparent PNG cutout of the subject (image only). `reframe` retargets the aspect ratio via AI outpaint/crop (aspect_ratio; async).

scene.description: model only — one of /v1/catalog scene ids (e.g. 'random', 'studio', 'beach'). Default 'random'.

pose.description: model only — one of /v1/catalog pose ids. Default 'random'.

size.description: Output size from /v1/catalog (e.g. 'PORTRAIT_HD_3_2'). Defaults: model → PORTRAIT_HD_3_2, ghost/flat → SQUARE_HD.

prompt.description: Optional style prompt. No prompt engineering required.

model_preset.description: model only — preset slug from /v1/catalog (e.g. 'avery'). Default 'avery'.

custom_model_id.description: model only — custom model id from /v1/catalog (kind=custom). Takes precedence over model_preset.

aspect_ratio.description: reframe only — target aspect ratio (default 1:1). Fails the generation when the source already matches within 2% (credits released).

duration.description: motion-video only — clip length in seconds. Default 5.

resolution.description: motion-video only — default 480p. Cost = 15 credits × unit (480p=1, 720p=3, 1080p=6; 10 s doubles).

value.prompt: slow elegant rotation, soft studio light

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST (payload does not validate) · MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE (unknown/disabled preset or custom id) · MOTION_VIDEO_DISABLED (motion video flag off) · INVALID_IMAGE_URL (not http/s) · DATA_URL_NOT_SUPPORTED

get.description: Newest first. Each entry carries its images with status (no URLs on list rows — poll the detail endpoint for URLs).

Authoritative status source. Poll every 2–5s until `status: "complete"`. `partial` = some images failed (error per image). `failed` = everything failed (reclaim: failed generations release their credits — you only pay for successes).

config_json.description: Raw stored config (JSON string) — mirrors what the pipeline executed.

url.description: Only present when status === complete. Stable bearer-authed download URL, no expiry.

delete.description: Removes the shoot, its images and pending credit reservations; stored outputs are deleted. Everything not yet charged is released.

post.description: Queues a fresh render of one image from the same stored config; charges the standard tool cost again.

202.description: Accepted — new queued image; poll the parent generation

409.description: IMAGE_IN_PROGRESS — that image is still queued/running

get.description: Returns the actual bytes (image/png for photo tools, video/mp4 for motion-video — content-type reflects the object). Stable URL, no expiry, immutable cache. Authorizes via the Bearer key (workspace-bound) on every fetch — never signed-token URL redirects.

parameters.name: imageId
parameters.description: Image id from the parent poll

get.description: One call on boot; refresh every few minutes only. Catalog changes via admin UI.
Same math as the studio plan page. Called with any valid key — returns the SHARED workspace pool.
